html:
SMTO-CTX-0003 — Your current request is too big for the model

GUID: 6c0db777-4ae3-4788-b1e2-d0a4c7cc01c6
Slug: protected-current-input-exceeds-context-window
Domain: CTX · Subsystem: context

What happened

  • SMTO already left out older parts of the conversation, but what this step must keep, your request and its attached material, still doesn't fit. The model wasn't asked anything for this step.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Start a new task with a shorter request, or split the work into several smaller tasks, and attach only the files each one needs. Your latest request and its attachments can't be cut, so making them smaller is the direct fix.
  2. If you have access to a model that can hold more text, choose it as the Main model in Settings › Setup › Model routing, then start a new task. Only a model that really handles more text can fit more, and new tasks pick up the change.
  3. Don't raise Output allowance, or set Context ceiling above what the model server supports. A bigger answer allowance leaves less room for your request, and a bigger number doesn't make the model hold more.

What success looks like

  • The new task's first step runs and the model replies without this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO, and ask them to confirm how much text the model server can really hold. Work the task already finished is kept; don't run it again.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Context preparation failed before inference because the protected current input (the current user turn and required task inputs) exceeds the model's input allowance even after removable history was compacted.

What this means

  • Context reduction could not bring the current protected input within the model’s input allowance. Older removable history has already been reduced through the bounded compaction path. A larger output reservation would leave still less input room; the current input or actual model capacity needs to change.

Why this can happen

  • The protected current input remains above the available input budget after the bounded history-reduction attempts.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare protected current input and total input with the hard input allowance. Check whether counts are estimated before treating them as an exact provider limit.

How to fix it

  • Compare protected_current_input_tokens and input_tokens_after_compaction with hard_input_limit_tokens (context_window_tokens minus reserved_output_tokens) in the error facts. Reduce or split the current request and its attachments, or route to a model whose served context window is genuinely larger (Settings › Setup › Model routing); do not raise max completion tokens, which shrinks input headroom.
  • Reduce or split the current request and protected inputs. Start a smaller task or use a model with genuinely larger served context capacity.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Confirm the next request passes context preflight.
  • Confirm existing completed tool results and receipts remain preserved without replay.

What not to do

  • Do not increase max completion tokens as the primary fix; reserving more output reduces input headroom.
  • Do not claim an inference response occurred when the model request did not start.

Technical notes

  • This capacity branch occurs before the next inference request starts. Prior tool receipts are preserved and token estimates retain provenance.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.

Do not confuse with / related errors

  • SMTO-CTX-0002 — A step's results were too large to send to the model
  • SMTO-CTX-0004 — This step needs more room than the model has
  • SMTO-CTX-0005 — Your request and the model's answer won't fit together
  • SMTO-CTX-0006 — Your request is too large for SMTO to plan the task
  • SMTO-CTX-0007 — Provider tokenizer rejected context
